about: Assertions written by this repository (aeoess), not by the anchor pointer draft or its author. They pin output fields that the draft 1.2 vectors leave unpinned, where the draft 1.2 README rule, or this repository's stated interpretation I6, fixes the value. Each value was worked out by hand from the vector inputs and the rule quoted in `rule`, not copied from reader output. vectors-1.2/vectors.json is unchanged. The draft 1.1 file supplemental.json is kept as the record of the 2d721cb run.

rule.failed_height: draft 1.2 README: root_mismatch checks the claimed block first, every attestation at a height must match, and the result names failed_height
rule.proof_heights: draft 1.2 README: proof_heights lists every height the proof names, ascending, distinct, as in AP-27. AP-29 expects it on root_mismatch. This repository's I6 reports it on every result from step 11 on (height_not_in_proof, header_unavailable, root_mismatch, anchored), so it is pinned on those vectors too
rule.set_checked: draft 1.2 README (unchanged from 1.1): true only when the digest comparison ran: false when no resource was given, when anchored_set is absent, and when the reader stopped at a select error. Steps 3 to 5 come after steps 1 and 2. This file reads 'true only when' as 'true exactly when', as the draft's own anchored vectors do
rule.verified_heights: draft 1.2 README (unchanged from 1.1): the reader verifies the claimed block and every other attestation whose header it was given. On anchored every supplied header matched, so this is every proof height with a supplied header, ascending
